mapper.select: SELECT task_no,business_no,state,attempt_count,claim_version,lease_owner,lease_until,retry_cycle_started_at created_at FROM process_task WHERE task_type='CREATE_ORDER' AND ((state='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT task_no,business_no,state,attempt_count,claim_version,lease_owner,lease_until,retry_cycle_started_at created_at FROM process_task WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND claim_version=#{claimVersion} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE

SELECT task_no,business_no,state,attempt_count,claim_version,lease_owner,lease_until,retry_cycle_started_at created_at FROM process_task WHERE task_type='CREATE_ORDER' AND business_no=#{businessNo} AND step='QUOTE_STOCK'

SELECT task_no,business_no,state,attempt_count,claim_version,lease_owner,lease_until,retry_cycle_started_at created_at FROM process_task WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} AND task_type='CREATE_ORDER' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE process_task SET state='READY',attempt_count=0,claim_version=claim_version+1,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),retry_cycle_started_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),manual_review_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} AND state='MANUAL_REVIEW'
